rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY since 1998-07-29

rows.author: A081
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSURING DUE PROCESS AND PREVENTING ABUSE IN THE ISSUANCE AND IMPLEMENTATION OF HOLD-DEPARTURE ORDERS, AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR ANY VIOLATION THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Provides that only the trial court where a criminal case is pending against a person for which a hold-departure order is being sought  has the EXCLUSIVE jurisdiction to issue hold-departure orders.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 1998-07-29

rows.author: A081
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT THE INCOME TAX RETURN SHALL BE THE PRINCIPAL BASIS FOR DETERMINING THE FINANCIAL CAPACITY OF A CREDIT APPLICANT BY BANKS AND OTHER FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR ANY VIOLATION THEREFOR, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION SEVENTY-SIX OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED THREE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-SEVEN, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Compels the taxpayer to declare his true income and pay the corresponding tax to the government in order to avail himself of good credit line to obtain banks loans.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 1998-07-29

rows.author: A081
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE REASSIGNMENT OF ELECTION REGISTRARS, PROVINCIAL ELECTION SUPERVISORS AND REGIONAL ELECTION DIRECTORS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE OMNIBUS ELECTION CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Directs the reassignment within thirty (30) days before the start of any election period, of those election officers who haver served for at least four (4) years in a particular locality.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 1998-07-29

rows.author: A081
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE AUTOMATIC REVIEW BY THE SECRETARY OF JUSTICE OF THE DECISION OF THE BOARD OF COMMISSIONERS IN DEPORTATION CASES, THEREBY AMENDING SECTION 37 OF COMMONWEALTH ACT NO. 613, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE PHILIPPINE IMMIGRATION ACT OF1940
rows.abstract: Provides that the decision of the Board of Commissioners in any deportation proceeding shall be ELEVATED to the Secretary of Justice for automatic review within ten (10) days from its promulgation and consequently he shall render his decision on thebasis of the records of the case within fifteen (15) days from his receipt thereof which shall be final and executory, unless within such period, the decision is restrained or enjoined by judicial process.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1998-07-29

rows.author: A081
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE PROMOTION OF BIO-ORGANIC FARMING IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Seeks to implement a comprehensive bio-organic farming program that will propagate bio-organic cultivation and production methods among the farmers and encourage research and development in the said field and hopes to alleviate the problems of industrial waste and community garbage disposal.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 1998-07-29

rows.author: A081
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO STRENGTHEN INDUSTRIAL PEACE THROUGH PROGRAMS INSTRUMENTAL IN PROMOTING BETTER LABOR MANAGEMENT RELATIONS
rows.abstract: "Industrial Peace Act of 1998".  Aims to promote healthy labor and management relations through strategies and programs taht uplift the dignity and welfare of Filipino labor and provide employers with skilled and disciplined workers who are worth paying for.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: A081
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO FOSTER LONG-TERM SOURCES OF DOMESTIC FINANCING BY PROVIDING INCENTIVES TO INDIVIDUALS TO INCREASE THEIR LONG-TERM SAVINGS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTIONS 20, 21 (C) AND 180 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 1998-07-29

rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE OQUENDO NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL IN BARANGAY OQUENDO, CALBAYOG CITY, INTO AN AGRICULTURAL HIGH SCHOOL TO BE KNOWN AS OQUENDO NATIONAL AGRICULTURAL HIGH SCHOOL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1998-07-29

rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE RAFAEL LENTEJAS MEMORIAL SCHOOL OF FISHERIES IN BARANGAY TINAMBACAN, CALBAYOG CITY, INTO A STATE COLLEGE TO BE KNOWN AS THE RAFAEL LENTEJAS MEMORIAL STATE COLLEGE OF FISHERIES AND MARINE SCIENCES AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1998-07-29

rows.author: A081
rows.title_full: AN ACT EXTENDING PROTECTION TO LABOR IN CASES OF WORK STOPPAGE, CLOSURE, FORECLOSURE, INSOLVENCY AND RECEIVERSHIP, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED FOUR HUNDRED AND FORTY-TWO, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: A081
rows.title_full: AN ACT GUARANTEEING THE CORRECT AND PROMPT PAYMENT OF WORKERS' WAGES AND OTHER BENEFITS PROVIDED BY LAW THROUGH THE BANKING SYSTEM, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SIXTY-SEVEN HUNDRED AND TWENTY-SEVEN, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE WAGES RATIONALIZATION ACT
rows.abstract: Requires all private establishments, companies, businesses and other entities with at least twenty five (25) employees and located within one (1) kilometers radius to a commercial, savings or rural bank to pay the wages and other benefits of their employees through any of the said banks. Prohibits the banks to require more than P100.00 as the lowest balance in individual accounts of employee.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: A081
rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPOSING EXCISE TAX ON CARBONATED DRINKS, FRUIT JUICE DRINKS AND POWDERED JUICE DRINKS, AND ON CERTAIN NON-ESSENTIAL ARTICLES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 150 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED, AND INSERTING A NEW SECTIONTHEREOF
rows.abstract: Imposes an ad valorem tax of ten percent (10%) of the manufacturer's and importer's wholesale price on carbon drinks, fruit juice drinks and powdered juice drinks, and twenty percent (20%) on non-essential goods.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1998-07-29

rows.author: A040
rows.mother_status: Bill reported out 2001-02-07 (#01447);Submitted by APPROPRIATIONS, GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION, TRANSP
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED 5173, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS AN ACT CREATING A PHILIPPINE COAST GUARD, PRESCRIBING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, APPROPRIATING THE NECESSARY FUNDS THEREFORE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES BY ESTABLISHING A SEPARATE AND DISTINCTPHILIPPINE COAST GUARD SERVICE ATTACHED TO THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Philippine Coast Guard Act of 1998". Separates the Philippine Coast Gurad from the Philippine Navy and attaches it to concentrate on its function of maritime safety administration, marine environmental protection, maritime search and rescue, including the enforcement of all applicable laws upon the high seas and waters.
rows.status: Substituted by HB12919

rows.author: A073
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL QUALITY EXCELLENCE AWARD (PNQEA) IN ORDER TO ENCOURAGE PHILIPPINE BUSINESS AND OTHER ORGANIZATIONS TO ACHIEVE EXCELLENCE IN QUALITY IN THE PROVISION OF THEIR GOODS AND SERVICES
rows.abstract: "Philippine National Quality Excellence Award Act of 1998". Aims to: (1) stimulate companies and organizations to attain excellence for the pride of achievement; (2) recognize outstanding companies and organization for others to emulate; (3) establish guidelines which business, governmental and other organizations can use to evaluate and improve their own quality efforts and (4) provide information to companies and organizations on how to manage for superior quality goods and services.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08118

rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE SALE OF IDLE LANDS OF THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL RAILWAYS AND ALLOCATING THE PROCEEDS THEREOF FOR THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PRIORITY PROJECTS OF THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT
rows.abstract: Mandates to DISPOSE OR SELL ALL IDLE LANDS and other unused properties of the Philippine National Railways and allocates the proceeds for programs of massive investment in irrigation, research and development and public works, the major projects forthe agricultural sector.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT ENTERPRISES AND PRIVATIZATION since 1998-07-29

rows.author: A068
rows.title_full: AN ACT ENHANCING THE EFFICIENCY OF THE GOVERNMENT BY IMPROVING PUBLIC ACCESS TO INFORMATION FOR EFFECTIVE POLICY FORMULATION, REDUCTION OF PAPERWORK, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Paperwork Reduction Act of 1998". Seeks to establish an integrated approach to management and control of information through the creation of Information and Regulatory Affairs Administration tasked to develop a five-year plan which shall meet the automatic data processing and other information technology needs of the government.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C113
rows.title_full: AN ACT ENCOURAGING INCREASED LEVELS OF SAVINGS AND INVESTMENTS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 24(B), 121, 122, AND 123 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: EXEMPTS interest income from the twenty (20%) percent withholding tax imposed on deposits to encourage savings and PHASES OUT the gross receipt tax (GRT) that forms part of the bank's intermediation cost which is passed on to the borrowers, thus contributing to the high lending rates.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C113
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING ACCELERATED DEPRECIATION DEDUCTION FOR INCOME TAX PURPOSES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 34(F) OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Provides for ACCELERATED DEPRECIATION for plant, machinery and equipment with the following features: (1) that these are reasonably needed and actually used for production and transport of good and services; (2) the privilege is available only if the asset  is depreciated under the straight-line method; and (3) the depreciation is available to all corporate or individual taxpayers as a matter of right.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C113
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE WATER AND SEWERAGE REGULATORY BOARD, DEFINING ITS COMPOSITION, POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Water Sewerage and Regulation Act". Mandates the Water and Sewerage Regulatory Baord to regulate water and sewerage services in the east and west concession zones by ensuring their compliance with international service quality standards and with the existing norms and the provisions of the concession contracts, thus protecting the interest of the consumers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 1998-07-29

rows.author: A069
rows.title_full: AN ACT LIBERALIZING BUSINESS IN THE RETAIL TRADE SECTOR OF THE PHILIPPINES, THEREBY REPEALING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 1180 AND FOR  OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Retail Trade Act of 1999". Ensures a reasonable measure of protection for small retail businesses by providing that retail business with paid-up capital of less than P5 Million Pesos shall be one hundred (100%) Filipino-owned and allowing only up to forty-nine (49%) percent foreign equity participation in enterprises with apaid-up capital of at least P5 Million but not more than P10 Million.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07602

rows.author: C122
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REVISE THE PHILIPPINE ENVIRONMENTAL CODE, DEFINING ITS SCOPE AND INTEGRATING ALL OTHER LAWS RELATIVE THERETO
rows.abstract: "Revised Philippine Environmental Code of 1998". Pursues the policy of balancing development and environmental protection by formulating the framework for sustainable development.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10651

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C032
rows.title_full: AN ACT MAKING THE CRIME OF MURDER COMMITTED AGAINST BARANGAY OFFICIALS WHO ARE KILLED IN THE LINE OF DUTY PUNISHABLE BY THE MAXIMUM PENALTY OF DEATH
rows.abstract: Seeks to minimize the occurrence of violence against barangay officials by imposing HARSHER penalties for those who commit murder against these officials.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1998-07-29

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE SALE THROUGH PUBLIC AUCTION OF ALL KINDS OF CONFISCATED SMUGGLED GOODS AND PRODUCTS, AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF
rows.abstract: Envisions to totally eradicate or eliminate the problem of graft and corruption in the activity of sale, through public auction, of confiscated goods by providing for the most possible appropriate scheme.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1998-07-29

rows.author: B012
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A HIGH SCHOOL IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF BILIRAN, PROVINCE OF BILIRAN, TO BE KNOWN AS BILIRAN NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING INSURANCE COVERAGE TO MEDICAL PRACTITIONERS IN THE RURAL AREAS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Provides for life, disability and personal accident insurance coverage for doctors, nurses, medical aides and other persons engaged in the delivery of medical services. States that such insurance coverage shall be availed of for death or injuries suffered while practicing their professions in the rural areas.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 1998-07-29

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING FIELD OFFICES OF THE BUREAU OF FOOD AND DRUGS IN PROVINCES AND CITIES AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Substantiates the Constitutional provision which states that the State shall establish and maintain an effective food and drug regulatory system and undertake appropriate health manpower development and research, responsive to the country's health needs and problems.
rows.status: Substituted by HB02089

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING THE DANGEROUS DRUGS ACT OF 1998, REPEALING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6425, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: "Dangerous Drugs Act of 1998". Imposes STIFFER penalty upon any person who will import prohibited or regulated drugs and dangerous drug preparations through a diplomatic passport, diplomatic facilities or any other means involving his official status intended to facilitate the unlawful entry of such dangerous drugs. Enumerates other unlawful acts with regard to prohibited drugs, regulated drugs and dangerous drug preparations with their corresponding penalties.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10665
